title: Every time I dream of this giant mall, this is the store I always visit first (described through meta Ai)
content: Beige tiles for wall. It consist of vinyl records and action figures. I'm not a collector and I have very little interest in music yet every time I come here I'd stay until lights shuts off. There are people inside yet nobody is talking to each other, we are all just growing looking at the same thing. At one point I grabbed a figure and stashed it in the back so one could grab it.
